subject.title: Feature request: first-class local Matrix/Element channel with E2EE, voice, and media support

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a first-class Matrix/Element channel in core, or direct this optional transport to an externally published plugin built on the existing channel/plugin seams?
rationale: The request introduces a substantial new channel, security model, media policy, and configuration surface; code review cannot choose the permanent ownership and support commitment.

options.title: Start as an external Matrix plugin
options.body: Define the smallest supported Matrix channel contract and publish it outside core, escalating only concrete missing SDK seams.

options.title: Sponsor a core channel program
options.body: Approve a staged core roadmap with explicit owners, E2EE/device-trust policy, media retention rules, and compatibility commitments.

options.title: Defer pending a narrower proposal
options.body: Keep the idea open until a maintainer-backed design identifies the intended deployment model and minimum viable support boundary.

recommendation.title: Start as an external Matrix plugin
recommendation.body: Define the smallest supported Matrix channel contract and publish it outside core, escalating only concrete missing SDK seams.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies the requester but not an evidenced current-main channel owner; maintainer routing should select the responsible channel/plugin owner separately.
